newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Vanda buys 75 pct stake in Comtech.
newsitem.headline: Vanda buys 75 pct stake in Comtech.

text.p: Vanda Systems & Communications Holdings Ltd said in a statement on Wednesday it had bought a 75 percent stake in The Comtech Group of Companies, a provider of telecommunications system integration.
The HK$65.4 million purchase would allow Vanda to capitalise on the potential of the lucrative telecommunication engineering market in Hong Kong and China, it said.
Comtech has branch offices in Bejing, Shanghai and Wuhan, and also supplies telecommunication services in Hong Kong.
The purchase would comprise a new issue of 12 million shares at HK$3.15 each share and a cash payment of HK$27.6 million.
To finance the cash payment, Vanda has entered into an agreement with J & A Securities (Hong Kong) Ltd to arrange for a placement of 9.66 million shares to independent third parties.
With the purchase, Vanda's total issued share capital will grow 10 percent from the current 216.6 million shares to 238.26 million shares, it said.
Three Vanda directors - Lam Hon-nam, Ma Chun-kwong Edmund and Wai Yee-jan - will sit on Comtech's board, but there will be no change in the day-to-day running of Comtech, it said.
